$comment: WORK-038-1 (RUN-005) synthesized SFX placeholders for DEC-049 (ASSET-018 5 -> 8): tick, riser, reveal. Same tool and rules as v1 (tools/assets/sfx-placeholders.mjs; pure sine partials, exponential envelopes, no noise, samples or speech; C major like the v1 set). A negative decay is a swell (the riser). Lengths sit >= 60 ms under the delegation limits to absorb AAC priming/padding. The v1 config stays as-is so the five v1 rows keep their SHA provenance.

entries.name: tick
entries.class: one soft tuned marimba-like note (C6 with a quiet 4th harmonic), pitch-stepped 0/+4/+7/+12 by detune

entries.name: riser
entries.class: soft upward shimmer: C5 -> C6 glide swelling in, a fifth above for shimmer

entries.name: reveal
entries.class: sparkle chime: G6 C7 E7 in quick succession, bell-like
